description: Count the alarms one paper mill raised inside a morning window across its two plant journals, where either file alone holds only part of the total. DISTILL-CANARY-b04a92f6

files.README.md:
# Grindale Paper Mill - plant journals

The boiler house and the turbine hall journal to separate files, both stamped
on site time. Alarms carry a code and the unit that raised them.
